$comment: The Conformance Units and Profiles this document defines. The Profiles and Conformance
Units clause is generated from this file; nothing here is authored in spec.md.
A unit's name appears in four places - this file, the Facet that requires it, the Category
element on every Node that implements it, and the profile database - so it is written once.
A Category the NodeSet carries that no unit here defines is reported, and so is a Facet
that requires a name nothing defines. Renaming a unit in one place and not the other is
the failure this arrangement exists to catch.
'group' on a unit is what a Facet table prints beside it; 'category' is Server or Client.
'group' on a Profile is the subclause it is listed under, and the groups appear in the
order they first occur here. An include names a unit or another Profile: optional=false
Name a unit '<SHORTNAME> <TypeName> <Aspect>'. The prefix keeps units from two parts of
one family apart when they are read side by side in the profile database.
